title: Relationship Installments on a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease End-of-Term Plan
content:
**Relationship schedule — additional installments for customers with current Kestrel contracts**

This schedule applies to lease-end installment plans on a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease.

**Clause.** The relationship installments added to a plan are 2 (the new-vehicle relationship installments) when the customer holds an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract or an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract that shows days past due of 0; 1 (the pre-owned relationship installment) when the customer holds no such contract but holds an active Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract that shows days past due of 0; and none otherwise. The installments are added to the plan's number of installments before the plan balance is divided. Where the customer's records for one of these products list more than one active contract, the first active contract listed for that product is the one read.

| Active new-vehicle retail (first listed) | Active balloon (first listed) | Active pre-owned retail (first listed) | Installments added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 days past due | — | — | 2 |
| 31 days past due | 0 days past due | — | 2 |
| 31 days past due | none | 0 days past due | 1 |
| none | none | 0 days past due | 1 |
| none | none | 6 days past due | none |
| none | none | none | none |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a lessee who also pays a current Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract, and holds no other Kestrel contract, has 1 installment added to the plan.
